properties.summary: Illustrative massing: the 14 new buildings of the approved 2025 master plan (three apartment buildings, two townhome groups, five office/R&D buildings, an amenity building and three parking garages) are drawn as their footprints on the plan's Conceptual Building Height Plan (Sheet G3.03, June 24, 2025), at its approximate parapet heights of 35 to 91 ft. The sheet calls these heights an illustrative example within the design standards' limits. Buildings P, S and T, which SRI keeps, stay in the base map; the affordable housing parcel and the public park have no building drawn. Nothing new has been built, and the 2026 Phase 2 proposal isn't drawn.
properties.note: Buildings are drawn from the approved 2025 plan's conceptual height plan; final designs come with each building's architectural control permit.

sheet_g3_03.method: street-centreline intersections matched to OpenStreetMap, least-squares similarity

project_plans.title: Parkline Master Plan Project Plans, project variant (June 24, 2025)

cdp_and_design_standards.title: City Council staff report 25-143-CC (Sept 30, 2025), CDP section 2.3.4 (p. J-1.587) and Design Standards (CDP Exhibit D, pp. J-1.627, J-1.651)
